<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (m/z ≈ 183.045 [M+H]⁺) the neutral mass is ~182 Da, corresponding to the formula C10H14O3. The 13C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon at ~169 ppm, six aromatic carbons between 124–133 ppm, and two aliphatic carbons at ~43 ppm (O‑CH₂) and ~26 ppm (CH₂). A structure that fits these features is a para‑substituted benzoic acid ester with a 2‑hydroxyethyl side chain: a benzoic acid bearing a –CH₂CH₂OH group at the para position and an –OH on the carbonyl (i.e., para‑hydroxyethyl benzoic acid). The SMILES for this compound is:

**c1ccc(cc1)C(=O)OCCO**

This SMILES yields the formula C10H14O3, matches the observed mass, and is consistent with the NMR data (aromatic ring, ester carbonyl, and O‑CH₂/CH₂ groups).
